inicio.kicker: Course · step 2 of the From chat to agent training · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Your Jarvis: an assistant with the memory and personality you define
inicio.lead: You understand the seven parts of an AI assistant, write who it is in four text files, ask a coding agent to build the core with tests, and connect it to Telegram. No programming needed: you decide, the agent builds, and the test confirms.
inicio.capa_alt: Dark desk with a phone open on a conversation, a laptop with a terminal, and a notebook: the personal assistant built by you.
inicio.aulas_sub: This is the deep dive for step 2. The overview of the four steps is in the From chat to agent course.

itens: People who have done step 1 (terminal, folders, and .env) and want an assistant of their own, not a chat website.
People who want to understand what's inside an agent before trusting it with their routine.
People who don't program, but are fine asking a coding agent and checking the work through the tests.

blocos.t: What you will be able to do
itens: Explain the seven parts of an agent and where each one sits in INTELECTO.
Write the SOUL, the AGENTS, the USER, and the MEMORY of your assistant.
Build the core with Claude Code or Codex and prove it with the tests.
Connect it to Telegram with a single owner, choose the brain using your own numbers, and use a routine for a week.
